evidence_supporting_choice: Exact process optimization in full window for Fe, Os, Ru; Fe feasible and lowest canonical cost among feasible checked set.

Cost breakdown shows Fe reactor+vessel and compression dominated by electricity/compression but overall much lower than noble-metal options due to low metal replacement cost (metal_cost ~0.07 USD/t vs Ru~1.83 and Os~2.16).
Co is infeasible due to bed-volume constraint.
